ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using IEInstal - Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using IEInstal.exe (UACMe 64)

sequences.query: ((process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\ieinstal\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("consent\\\.exe$"))
